_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. Starting with a focus on PC graphics, we extended our focus in recent years to the revolutionary field of artificial intelligence, or AI.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change and evolving industry standards.' Its current competitors include 'suppliers and licensors designing discrete and integrated GPUs and other accelerated computing solutions, including chipsets that incorporate 3D graphics, or HPC, such as Advanced Micro Devices, or AMD, Intel Corporation, or Intel, and Xilinx, Inc.' (FY2020 10-K); CYCLICAL kept although the 10-K no longer calls the business cyclical (the BKR FY2015 rule; the class label only); the 10-K names AI as a field NVIDIA has extended its focus to, a market it serves rather than a substitute for its products, so no theme in taxonomy_eras.json applies (the FY2013 10-K's cloud reading), and GPUs integrated into other processors stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -31.8%/yr (worst year FY11-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +54.1%/yr (Q4 FY21 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +54.1%/yr (FY11-FY20 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +111.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY20, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2020-12-04) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (94.3% downside to Bear $30.66 / -27.0% upside to Bull $395.94) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 3.43: gap -1.28 [OVERVALUED] | +606% above the EPP floor $76.84 (17x FY21E $4.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: -59.3% total (-29.6%/yr) | At 120.0x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $717.23 sits above the BULL case; revenue +56.8% YoY in Q3 FY21, forward revenues +51.5-57.7% (Q4 FY21 revenue guide (Q3 FY21 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
